我们为他所有的笑话尽责地笑了，即使是那些不好笑的笑话。

en: something that you feel you have to do because it is your moral or legal responsibility
ex: It is my duty to report it to the police.
把这事报告给警方是我的责任。

zh: a moral or legal obligation to ensure that other people are safe from physical or mental harm
en: a moral or legal obligation to ensure that other people are safe from physical or mental harm
ex: Employers have a duty of care to their employees.
雇主有责任照顾自己的雇员。

zh: （警察、军队等的）值勤官，值班员
en: the officer, for example in the police, army, etc., who is on duty at a particular time in a particular place
having to do something because it is your duty
ex: I felt duty-bound to help him.
我觉得帮助他责无旁贷。

en: that you can bring into a country without paying tax on them
ex: duty-free cigarettes
免税香烟

en: a shop in an airport or on a ship, etc. that sells goods such as cigarettes, alcohol, perfume, etc. without tax on them
a large cloth bag that is filled with feathers or other soft material and that you have on top of you in bed to keep yourself warm
ex: a duvet cover (= a cover that you can wash, that you put over a duvet)
羽绒被套

zh: 羽绒被拥卧日；偷懒假日；偷闲日
en: a day when you stay at home instead of going to work because you feel tired and want to rest but are not ill
ex: Some firms allow their staff two duvet days a year.
一些公司每年允许员工两天的羽绒被。

zh: 尖子生；成绩最好的学生
en: the top student in a school or class
ex: Miranda was dux of Girton Grammar School and received the highest VCE score.
米兰达（Miranda）是吉顿文法学校（Girton Grammar School）的偶像，并且获得了最高的VCE分数。
